newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-BATISTUTA LEFT OUT OF ARGENTINA SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BATISTUTA LEFT OUT OF ARGENTINA SQUAD.

text.p: Gabriel Batistuta, one of Argentina's top players, was left out of the national team squad for the third consecutive game on Tuesday.
Batistusta's name was missing from the list announced by coach Daniel Passarella for the crucial World Cup qualifying tie at home to Ecuador in two weeks' time.
He was also absent from the previous games away to Colombia and Bolivia, despite having been praised by Passarella for his performance against Uruguay in his last outing.

Official explanations are that Batistuta, who holds the record for the number of goals scored for the national team, is not technically compatible with Hernan Crespo, a striker who Passarella regards as indispensable.
But many in Argentina also feel personal problems, similar to the ones which have kept midfielder Fernando Redondo out of the team, may to to blame.
Batistuta also played under Passarella at Buenos Aires club River Plate in his early playing days but his career only took off after the two parted.
Uncapped defender Jorge Martinez of Independiente was named in a squad, which included 10 foreign-based players.

Argentina, who suffered a shock defeat away to Bolivia two weeks ago and cannot afford to drop any points, are fifth in the South American group, trailing Ecuador on goal differential. The top four in the nine-team group qualify for France.
As well as the points, Argentina desperately need a good performance, having struggled against teams that only a few years ago represented little more than sparring partners.
They were beaten away to Ecuador, who had the advantage of playing at altitude, and have dropped home points against Paraguay and Chile.
In addition to their performances, Argentina were criticised for their behaviour against Bolivia when they had two players sent off and were involved in a huge brawl at the end of the game.
Goalkeepers - Pablo Cavallero (Velez Sarsfield), Ignacio Gonzalez (Racing Club), Carlos Roa (Lanus).
Defenders - Roberto Ayala (Napoli), Jose Chamot (Lazio), Jorge Martinez (Independiente), Pablo Paz (Tenerife), Mauricio Pineda (Boca Juniors), Roberto Sensini (Parma).

Midfielders - Matias Almeyda (Sevilla), Leonardo Astrada (River Plate), Christian Bassedas (Velez Sarsfield), Sergio Berti (River Plate), Hugo Morales (Lanus), Ariel Ortega (Valencia), Diego Simeone (Atletico Madrid), Juan Sebastian Veron (Sampdoria).
Forwards - Jose Luis Calderon, (Independiente), Hernan Crespo (Parma), Claudio Lopez (Valencia)
